data.title: Elder Account — Large Cash Withdrawal with Crypto ATM Deposit Indicators
data.description: Detects the elder-targeted crypto ATM fraud pattern where victims aged 60+ make large cash withdrawals with no corresponding deposit or transfer activity within 48 hours — a strong indicator that funds were deposited at a crypto ATM/kiosk under the direction of a scammer. FBI IC3 2025 data shows 6,188 crypto ATM complaints and $257 million in losses from victims aged 60+ (66% of all crypto ATM fraud losses). The 48-hour gap between bank withdrawal and lack of corresponding activity represents the detection window before funds become irrecoverable on-chain. This rule targets the P4 execution phase where bank-side intervention can still prevent loss.

enrichment_required.source: Boolean — whether any deposit, transfer, or payment was made from the account within 48 hours of the cash withdrawal

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Elder Crypto ATM Deposit Pattern
// Detects cash withdrawals by 60+ account holders with no follow-up activity
account_holder_age>=60
transaction_type="cash_withdrawal"
transaction_amount>=5000
followup_deposit_or_transfer_48h="false"
| groupBy(account_id, function=[
    collect([account_holder_age, transaction_amount, transaction_date, branch_id]),
    count(transaction_id, as=withdrawal_count),
    sum(transaction_amount, as=total_withdrawn)
  ])
| sort(total_withdrawn, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Elder Crypto ATM Deposit Pattern")`
`comment("Detects cash withdrawals by 60+ account holders with no follow-up activity within 48h")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  transaction_type="cash_withdrawal"
  account_holder_age>=60
  transaction_amount>=5000
| eval withdrawal_time = _time
| join type=left account_id
  [search index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
    (transaction_type="deposit" OR transaction_type="transfer" OR transaction_type="payment")
  | eval followup_time = _time
  | where followup_time > withdrawal_time AND followup_time < (withdrawal_time + 172800)
  | stats count AS followup_count by account_id]
| where isnull(followup_count) OR followup_count=0
| stats count AS withdrawal_count, sum(transaction_amount) AS total_withdrawn,
    values(branch_id) AS branches, latest(transaction_date) AS last_withdrawal
    by account_id, account_holder_age
| sort - total_withdrawn

references: FBI IC3, 2025 Internet Crime Report — Crypto ATM/kiosk fraud: 13,460 complaints, $389M losses; 60+ victims: 6,188 complaints, $257M
FinCEN guidance on money services business obligations for crypto ATM operators
falsepositives: Elderly customers making large cash withdrawals for legitimate purposes (home purchases, estate settlements)
Snowbird customers withdrawing cash before extended travel
Cash-preferred customers with established patterns of large withdrawals
Customers withdrawing funds to deposit at another institution
